text: Dish: Recipe. Cuisine: Indian. Ingredients: Salt, lemon, ginger paste, garlic paste, ripe mangoes, raw mangoes, chillies, pepper, cumin seeds, mustard oil. Steps: Marinate the ingredients for 20-30 minutes to allow for initial flavor absorption. Prepare a fine paste from the raw mangoes and chillies. Grind pepper and cumin seeds into a well-mixed powder. Heat mustard oil in a pot for tempering. Smeared Kashmiri Lanka with mustard oil in the pot Add the marinated mixture to the pot with mustard oil. Simmer the mixture gently, stirring occasionally, until it reaches desired consistency. Adjust seasoning with salt and lemon juice to taste. Serve hot as a side dish..
